chars.H: the HUSBAND: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans.
chars.W: the WIFE: a visibly pregnant young woman with a round baby bump, wearing a long lilac knit dress and a white headband.
chars.C: the COWORKER: a man wearing a slim light-grey suit with a red tie and a thin black moustache.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Modern apartment living room in the evening. The pregnant wife sits on a sofa turning her phone screen away and hiding it against her chest with a guilty nervous smile, while the husband sits next to her leaning in and staring at her and the phone with narrowed suspicious eyes. Open tension between them, slightly comic.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Apartment entrance hallway. The tired pregnant wife comes home from work holding her bag and rubbing her back, the husband greets her from the living room doorway. Warm evening light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Living room. The pregnant wife walks toward a bathroom door carrying a towel, leaving her glowing smartphone face-up and unlocked on the coffee table. The husband on the sofa glances sideways at the phone with wide tempted eyes.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Living room. The husband crouches by the coffee table nervously picking up his wife's phone with both hands, looking over his shoulder at a closed bathroom door with steam coming out from under it. Sneaky comic tiptoe pose.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The husband sits on the sofa holding the phone close to his face, scrolling with one finger, eyebrows raised in surprise, the phone screen lighting his face in the dim room. The screen is turned away from the viewer.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A modern office at a desk with a computer. The coworker leans back in his office chair texting on his phone with a sly flirty smirk, one eyebrow raised.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Living room. The husband stands frozen holding the phone, jaw dropped and eyes huge in shock, sweat drops flying around his head, a dramatic comic shock moment.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Living room. The husband holds his wife's phone in one hand and with his own phone in the other hand takes photos of its screen, focused and angry, like collecting evidence.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Living room next to an open bathroom door with steam. The pregnant wife steps out in a bathrobe wrapped over her baby bump with a towel on her head and freezes in shock, while the husband stands facing her and holds up her phone toward her with a stern accusing look. Both characters fully visible.
